questions.stem: A woman in labour presented to the ER. A vaginal breech delivery was planned for her. What statement regarding the management is false? (INICET MAY 2020)

options.label: A
options.text: Breech identified for the first-time during delivery is a contraindication for normal delivery

options.label: B
options.text: Breech delivery is done in a hospital where a facility for emergency CS is available

options.label: C
options.text: Continuous FHR monitoring is required for breech delivery during labor

options.label: D
options.text: Should be done by a skilled obstetrician
